title: Daily X narrative digest - 2026-10-26

hits.name: Sample Builder
hits.hook: A Claude Code checklist caught a poisoned README before lunch.
hits.text: Claude Code just shipped a checklist for prompt injection inside agent repos. I ran it on three codebases before lunch and it flagged a poisoned README.

hits.name: Sample Maker
hits.hook: Put the prompt injection test in the first pull request.
hits.text: Teams keep pasting secrets into Claude Code. A prompt injection test belongs in the first pull request, not the postmortem.
hits.video_tip: Still image of a pull request comment that says the check ran, with the secret line redacted.

hits.name: Sample Writer
hits.hook: The useful setup is a rules file plus one check.
hits.text: The useful Claude Code setup is boring: one rules file, short tasks, and a prompt injection check on every README the agent reads.
hits.video_tip: Text card, three lines, no music: rules file, short task, README check.

hits.name: Sample Lab

hits.video_tip: Split screen: model settings unchanged on the left, the cloned README on the right.
